translationRepairs: In the first month of spring (which was the sixth month), His Majesty performed the plowing ceremony at Shanglin Park.
In the first month of spring of the sixth year, His Majesty performed the plowing ceremony at Shanglin Park.

Chapter s0061’s 六月春正月 is impossible (sixth month cannot be spring’s first month) and follows year-five autumn events before 二月; CText’s Han Shu witness restores 六年春正月, so the idiomatic must read sixth year, not sixth month.
Sixth month spring first month: His Majesty plowed at Shanglin.
Sixth year spring first month: His Majesty plowed at Shanglin.
The same corrupt 六月 must be read as 六年; CText’s edition has 六年春正月，上耕于上林, so the literal correctly replaces “Sixth month” with “Sixth year.”
Twelfth month Gengxu: Chancellor Yin died.
Twelfth month Gengxu: Chancellor Xin died.
Focus unit 丞相訢 gives the personal name 訢 (Xin); the idiomatic already has Xin, and literal “Yin” is a misreading with no support in the Chinese.
